Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

This revolutionary design from Biodyne takes decades-old climbing gloves and scales them down to fit into the user’s palms and fingers! Who needs grip feet when you can stick to walls like a superhero?

Cyberhand Option. Requires two Cyberhands and must be paired. Negates the normal movement penalty for climbing, but only when climbing a wall or similar near-vertical surface. If the user also has paired Grip Feet, then when they use the Run Action while climbing such a surface, their movement increases by 6m/yds.

NOTE: This is vaguely based on a specific shard in Cyberpunk 2077 which mentions it.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
